candidate_relations.reason: Epidermoid cyst is a standard synonym for epidermal inclusion cyst; the added presacral anatomy is compatible with the anterior-to-rectum lesion. The parenthetical dermoid terminology is used loosely here.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Epidermoid cyst at the presacral/pelvic site

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Congenital tailgut-remnant cyst rather than epidermal inclusion cyst

candidate_relations.reason: A perineural cyst is a distinct neural cystic entity and is not an epidermal inclusion cyst.
A pudendal nerve schwannoma is a different, typically solid neoplasm rather than an epidermal inclusion cyst.
Tailgut cyst is a distinct entity from epidermal inclusion cyst; the asserted multilocular morphology also conflicts with the described unilocular lesions.
Tailgut cyst is a separate congenital developmental lesion and does not identify an epidermal inclusion cyst.
A Tarlov cyst is a CSF-containing perineural cyst, not an epidermal inclusion cyst.
Perineal cyst is compatible with the location and morphology of one component but omits the required epidermal inclusion etiology and the pelvic component.
